inspection.method: 102 continuous ordinary held-button intervals from a clean boot, 80 memory payloads and one OAM inspection, authenticated source debug and an official save-only continuation checkpoint. scope: Two genuine jobs complete with full condition: Market Start pays 109 to cash 139; early braking delivers Distillery Files for credit 124 to cash 263 / done 2 / bitmap 05.
An isolated human impact charges 20 (263 to 243 / H1). With no repeat stationary charge, ordinary parking/walking reaches a funded H1 police stop (243 to 218 / H0 / message 20).

After the foot courier moves clear of King, sampled police positions return through connected Core road corridors, with actual authored target leg 2 changing to leg 0. No reset or scene change supplies the return.
Original-car re-entry is followed by separate impacts charging 20 then 40 (218 to 198 to 158 / H2). A funded H2 on-foot police stop charges 100 (158 to 58 / H0 / message 20).

The final neutral frame retains done 2 / bitmap 05, cash 58, foot 717.75/564.25 and Core car 818.75/663.75. The official checkpoint is save-only with zero automatic advance; its opaque state/file is not published or restored.

recording.reason: Scoped exact d58 ordinary-control run: two genuinely completed contracts with full-condition pay, isolated funded H1/H2 on-foot captures, no-repeat stationary impact and same-scene driven patrol rejoin, original-car recovery, official neutral continuation checkpoint. Quiet escape, paid-mode suppression, all campaign and hardware remain pending.

historicalComparison.scope: This third d58 replay adds only its own lower-heat capture/return observations. The earlier 103-step bus and 137-step three-job/H3 records remain separate; historical Queen 5ae4 and Island campaign 7b2 evidence retain their own ROM identities.

limitations: H1/H2 capture is funded and on foot in Core. Moving-car captures at these levels, every patrol-return route, cross-district chase continuity, quiet escape/decay and suppression across all paid modes remain unverified.
Patrol endpoints and leg bytes are sampled; no exact unsampled (48,184) arrival, complete per-update path or teleport-free behavior across every possible route is claimed.
The first received frame-180 memory payload lacks its original wrapper. Labels describe intent; actual geometry and authenticated address layouts control interpretation.
This record does not reset, change scene or restore its official continuation checkpoint. It is not SRAM cold-boot, native older-save migration, power-off persistence or checkpoint-restore evidence.

Two genuine completions do not establish all 96 contracts, eight remaining Island jobs, full Old Toronto, two measured enjoyable human hours, balance, crowded pacing, deepest stack, browser recovery or physical cartridge acceptance.
The OAM read is sampled, with tool-reported peak six of ten and no over-limit lines. It is not an all-city sprite or CPU-latency benchmark.
Relative paths and hashes are evidence locators, not public downloads. No opaque emulator state, SRAM save, PNG binary, activation state or host absolute path is embedded.
